recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5806 unless Pharmacy later chooses to revise broader MedicationStatement narrative wording independently of this DSTU1 short-description request.
issue_request: FHIR-5806 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU1 asking to replace MedicationStatement text 'Administration of medication to a patient' with 'Record of medication being taken by a patient'.
initial_application: Historical commit 693de2abe422cacfbd836f64311b4e744b99884c explicitly references #5806 and changes the then-authoritative MedicationStatement spreadsheet short description from 'Administration of medication to a patient' to 'Record of medication being taken by a patient'. Later source refactors carried the wording into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has the requested short description at source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml:79. Exact-phrase repository searches found the old wording only in historical release artifacts or in other-resource contexts such as MedicationAdministration/MedicationRequest, not as the current MedicationStatement short text. Jira search found only FHIR-5806 for the exact wording, Zulip hits were unrelated IG profile excerpts, and Confluence searches found no FHIR-5806 references.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative MedicationStatement source already satisfies the Jira request.
